equivalence_scope: full-client shell parity plus production-readiness gate
current_behavior_checkpoints: Signed-out onboarding exposes manual sign-in, QR sign-in and create-account routes.
Manual password login can use Matrix Client-Server REST calls.
No-credential sessions remain available as fixture-backed UI regression mode.
Signed-in shell exposes Home, Timeline, Settings and Devices tabs.
The migrated user status, gallery media, active call, live location and link-new-device feature surfaces are integrated into the unified shell.
Room selection, timeline rendering, composer, read receipts, read markers, profile editing, ignored users and selected moderation actions have ArkTS implementations.
production_blockers: No Harmony native bridge to the Matrix Rust SDK or fully equivalent ArkTS Matrix SDK runtime is present.
End-to-end encryption, verification, recovery, key backup and encrypted media are not production-complete.
Android service properties such as RoomListService, EncryptionService, PushersService, NotificationSettingsService and MatrixMediaLoader are not exposed as equivalent live ArkTS services.
Android Flow/StateFlow semantics are represented by synchronous snapshots in selected contract members.
Fixture room and timeline data paths remain in the runtime for offline UI regression.
Session persistence uses preferences-backed storage and is not a complete secure token/crypto store.
The REST implementation is a useful Client-Server subset, not complete Element X Matrix SDK parity.
